title: 5 Holiday-Friendly Hues You’ll Love All Year
summary: The holidays have a way of inspiring us to spruce up our spaces. We're sharing some shades that are perfect for the holidays and beyond.
body_markdown:
The holidays have a way of inspiring us to spruce up our spaces. Updating a paint color or two is one of the easiest ways to bring a fresh feel. The best colors don’t just shine during the season, though. They continue to bring comfort, character and style long after the decorations are packed up and put away. We’re sharing five of our favorite paint colors that are perfect for the holidays and all year round.


Featured Color: *[Zircon SW 7667](https://www.sherwin-williams.com/en-us/color/color-family/neutral-paint-colors/SW7667-zircon)*
Photo Courtesy of *[@lexi.pratz](https://www.instagram.com/p/CljIc0hr0vt/?hl=en)*


## Zircon SW 7667


If you love a light, bright look,[Zircon](https://www.sherwin-williams.com/en-us/color/color-family/neutral-paint-colors/SW7667-zircon) is an easy favorite. This soft neutral gives entryway spaces a fresh and welcoming feel from the moment you walk through the door. It’s the kind of color that works with everything, whether you’re decorating with holiday accents in December or keeping things simple the rest of the year.


Featured Color: *[Evergreen Fog SW 9130](https://www.sherwin-williams.com/en-us/color/color-family/green-paint-colors/SW9130-evergreen-fog)*
Photo Courtesy of *[@housetohomediydesign](https://www.instagram.com/p/CUI115apmYx/?hl=en&img_index=1)*


## Evergreen Fog SW 9130


[Evergreen Fog](https://www.sherwin-williams.com/en-us/color/color-family/green-paint-colors/SW9130-evergreen-fog) has a way of making a space feel calm and collected without trying too hard. Used on bedroom wainscoting, it adds just enough contrast and depth to make the room feel cozy and pulled together. Pair it with light neutrals, soft bedding and layered textures for a look that’s equal parts relaxing and timeless.


Featured Color: *[Charcoal Blue SW 2739](https://www.sherwin-williams.com/en-us/color/color-family/blue-paint-colors/SW2739-charcoal-blue)* (door); *[Pearly White SW 7009](https://www.sherwin-williams.com/en-us/color/color-family/white-paint-colors/SW7009-pearly-white)* (trim)
Photo Courtesy of *@houseofblues*


## Charcoal Blue SW 2739


Want to give your front door a little more personality?[Charcoal Blue](https://www.sherwin-williams.com/en-us/color/color-family/blue-paint-colors/SW2739-charcoal-blue) strikes the perfect balance between bold and classic, making a memorable first impression without feeling over the top. It looks extra-festive paired with a holiday wreath, but its rich, sophisticated color feels at home well beyond the holiday season.


Featured Color: *[Snowbound SW 7004](https://www.sherwin-williams.com/en-us/color/color-family/white-paint-colors/SW7004-snowbound)*
Photo Courtesy of *@shadyoaklane__*


## Snowbound SW 7004


[Snowbound](https://www.sherwin-williams.com/en-us/color/color-family/white-paint-colors/SW7004-snowbound) proves that white paint doesn’t always feel cold. This versatile favorite brings a bright, airy feel to dining spaces while still offering a touch of warmth. Whether you’re hosting a holiday dinner or a weeknight meal with family, it’s a color that makes the whole room feel inviting and effortlessly fresh.


Featured Color: *[Rock Bottom SW 7062](https://www.sherwin-williams.com/en-us/color/color-family/green-paint-colors/SW7062-rock-bottom)*
Photo Courtesy of *[@rehabby_home](https://www.instagram.com/p/CkrSdPGpkjj/?hl=en)*


## Rock Bottom SW 7062


Few things feel cozier than curling up near a fireplace, and[Rock Bottom](https://www.sherwin-williams.com/en-us/color/color-family/green-paint-colors/SW7062-rock-bottom) was made for these moments. Its deep, moody character adds warmth and depth, creating a memorable and inviting space. While it feels especially fitting during the colder months, this rich green brings comfort and character to a room no matter the season.


## Bring These Colors Home


Found a favorite? Before you commit to color, try it in your own space. Order[FREE color chip samples](https://samples.sherwin-williams.com/?colors=SW7667-S,SW9130-S,SW2739-S,SW7004-S,SW7062-S) of the whole palette to see how these shades look in your home, so you can feel confident before you pick up a paintbrush.
